title: Deadly Skeletons
description: Turns Skeletons into a serious late-game threat by overhauling their combat equipment and spawn rules.
body:
☠️ Deadly Skeletons (Hard Mode Only)

 Deadly Skeletons modifies the spawn and equipment mechanics of Skeletons and Strays.
 The goal is to turn Skeletons into a real threat in the later stages of the game.

---

 Core Mechanics

 1. Enchanted Bows

* All Skeletons always spawn with enchanted bows
* Bow enchantments:

  * Power V
  * Flame I
* Lower-level or unenchanted bows are never used
  

 2. Armor System

* When the game difficulty is set to **Hard**:

  * Skeletons have a **50% chance** to spawn with a full set of iron armor
  * Only **one armor piece** has **Protection V**
  * The remaining armor pieces are unenchanted

---

3. Compatibility Note

* This mod modifies the Skeleton `initEquipment` method using Mixins
* It may conflict with other mods that change Skeleton equipment or spawn behavior
